title: Summarising tensors during TypeCheckError rather than printing them in full
author: christopher-beckham

comments.author: patrick-kidger
comments.body:
Thanks for the suggestion! Right now we do actually currently do this if you have [Equinox](https://github.com/patrick-kidger/equinox) installed, in which case we use its pretty-printing facilities to render tensors as e.g. `f32[2,4]`.

Cutting that (implicit) dependency is on the roadmap. I've now written a standalone pretty-printing library for this purpose; I expect to open-source that and have jaxtyping+Equinox(+two other not-yet-released projects) all depend on it.

comments.author: christopher-beckham
comments.body: Hi Patrick, thanks for pointing this out. :) Yes the pprint now seems seems sufficient. I'll close the issue.
